title.narrative: Operation of the National Blood Bank in Mogadishu

description.narrative: Contributing to building the infrastructure of the health sector and localizing the service in the region by activating specialized medical centers (National Blood Bank) Improving the level of health services provided in the Republic of Somalia and enhancing coordination between health facilities to obtain the services of the National Blood Bank Contributing to building the capacities of local cadres to preserve and transfuse blood to those in need

Improving the level of health services provided in the Federal Republic of Somalia and enhancing coordination between health facilities to obtain the services of the National Blood Bank, securing safe blood and its components and saving the lives of patients in need of blood transfusion, early detection of blood diseases and blood-borne diseases, clarifying the obstacles that prevent blood donation, enhancing, educating and raising awareness of donors and motivating them to donate blood and its benefits to their health and serving their community humanely, which keeps the blood bank balance enhanced with all blood types and components, contributing to building the infrastructure of the health sector and localizing the service in the region by activating specialized medical centers (National Blood Bank), reducing the number of deaths by securing safe blood units and its appropriate components in terms of (quality, type and quantity) at the appropriate time, reducing the spread of epidemic, infectious and blood-borne diseases and applying infection control standards, contributing to building the capacities of local cadres through the training and education program and blood donation and care services and the safe method of preserving and transfusing blood to those in need, enhancing the disposal of medical waste in a safe manner, establishing an electronic system by automating the data of donors, beneficiaries and entities Beneficiary through the database

The project intervention will be aligned with the strategic objectives of the Humanitarian Response Plan: Reduce mortality and morbidity among women, girls, boys and men affected by the crisis through the timely, safe and equitable delivery of life-saving humanitarian assistance, and Improve the resilience of vulnerable women, girls, men and boys of all ages affected by the crisis through increased safe, dignified and adequate access to multi-sectoral response and sustainable solutions.
